notes.title: 48 hours left in our Kickstarter Campaign!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/66e2eb2765fe845bc32f7644b18f54ebfb3f10cb.png

My Fellow Ravens!

We're in the crucial final hours of our Kickstarter campaign!
Allow me to share some stats with all of you:

(1) The big one first: We've raised over USD $105,000 with the help of ~2200 of you (and there's still 48 hours to go!) I cannot believe the insane showing of support for our little project 🤯 truly and deeply humbled by all of your support - you have ensured that this passion project of ours will see the light of day and to that end, no amount of thanks and appreciation will ever be enough to how much it means to us. 

You are our lifeblood, and we will endeavor on. Thank you 🙇🏻

(2) we're just 65 discord members away from unlocking our Nintendo Switch stretch goal! you can find out more about it here:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gatherroundstudios/the-white-raven/posts/3565578

if you're interested, you can help by joining us here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/263732917a7a7f9cbcb69fa60236f2033df947a2.png


(3) We also reached 2000 backers and in doing so, having unlocked Brazilian Portuguese localization for The White Raven! Here's a list of languages that we're currently introducing to our game - we might add more before our 1.0 launch however!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/a3d5392b54f34fe9c0ce0dc68db157dc7e55e2d6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5d8ab9cf2812b26054b724f9c1794de648cdb5a.png

(4) we've also decided to introduce some last minute surprise rewards for the campaign!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/58ca0b42360907ceff827b8f7eb559569ece0552.jpg

First up is a T-shirt design that features our main characters! Still a work in progress for now (we might end up adding all our unannounced confidants as well😉).

Unisex Sizes: 2XS – 3XL 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/46f73d5ed3b821a931ae135b1050200579676fe9.jpg

Next up is an Kickstarter-exclusive poster (only for backers):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/1f6f373222374541dcafd6b4d3e181cd2829e50e.jpg

Again, these are mockups and designs will be subject to change! but no worries as we'll be updating you when we've come up with the final design - we promise that it'll be look plenty awesome😎


(approx.) Dimensions: A3 (297 mm x 420 mm or 11.7 in x 16.5 in)


They're currently priced at SGD $28 (~ USD $20) for the T-shirt and SGD $10 (~ USD $7) for the poster which you can purchase when our Backerkit survey is sent out after the campaign but we'll also be introducing an exclusive tier: "The Collector's Guild" (only available during the campaign) where you can get them both at a discounted price of SGD $28! (~USD $20)


All tiers starting at "The Inner Circle" and above will also get these as an option at no extra cost as well😄

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5d8ab9cf2812b26054b724f9c1794de648cdb5a.png

Finally we're introducing a little secret we've been working on...

Introducing the Midnight Panther pet!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/3f2f2a5608d31b05a896fd468cb9cfd3ccbe36c8.png

This is a Kickstarter - exclusive pet that we've decided to introduce - the Midnight Panther!
We've been affectionately referring to her as Luna - would you be interested in caring for her?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/60b4f4c5e69541193e5c7a53b19aad2318b09723.gif

And of course you'd be able to name her whatever you'd like!

She'll be faithfully waiting for you in your tribe - guarding your valuables, waiting for headpats, showing you her captured prey, etc.

We'll be introducing her under a new reward called "The Midnight Panther" where you can obtain your very own Luna!

Also included at no extra cost for all exclusive tiers starting at "House of Hundreds" and above!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5d8ab9cf2812b26054b724f9c1794de648cdb5a.png


Let's try our best to take off during these last 48 hours everyone! If you're interested in joining us (or just simply would like to have to have a look at some more details of The White Raven), click the gif below to take a peek!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5ed548f156db8b151bff0dca32d13d0d3a4d5cd.gif


Cheers everyone, and welcome to the beginning of The White Raven.

- August

notes.title: Mid-campaign report!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/73e2212f66d85311fdfaac03cf1f8c0789cdb6b1.gif

My Fellow Ravens!

We've just crossed the midpoint of our Kickstarter campaign. 
Here are some interesting numbers of note!:

(1) We got funded in a day! Over 400+ of you showed up on the first day to make The White Raven a reality, and I cannot overstate the importance of that. 
You have made all the difference. Thank you.

(2) We just smashed through 2 of our stretch goals with over 1300+ of you! Minigames within the tribe and an expansion of the hidden areas of The White Raven have been unlocked. Breaking through 1000 backers has also enabled us to bring Japanese Localization to the game! 

(3) We just introduced new Kickstarter-exclusive physical rewards! We're bringing a physical artbook and tarot cards (more info here) into our campaign - NOTE: They will never be re-introduced ever again, so grab yours while you still can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/bbdc1169615503211fc859862169cac3b8646844.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/778cdb4c17aa0ee228502ec6115d3504ffa99e3a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5d8ab9cf2812b26054b724f9c1794de648cdb5a.png



Social Goals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/d54bf757ec0653909d4d50fd479817648674f3e1.jpg

We've also decided to add some social goals that'll enable us to add additional content (that everyone will be able to enjoy!) into the game.


If you're interested to participate, click the links below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/263732917a7a7f9cbcb69fa60236f2033df947a2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/0496037cedc1d310f953cb9ece8ba79b770eb6e6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/46551f06bcb2120790f81d855b1b03cc7ca5bc78.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5d8ab9cf2812b26054b724f9c1794de648cdb5a.png

Oh and if you're interested in our campaign (or would like to know more info on The White Raven), You can swing by our Kickstarter page by clicking the gif below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5ed548f156db8b151bff0dca32d13d0d3a4d5cd.gif


Till we meet again,
August

notes.title: We're Live on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/8ac466ec05e3179709dbaff8ebc8ea8c8177986e.gif

And We're Live on Kickstarter!

As mentioned previously, we'll be showing off a ton of new details about the game so if you'd like to learn more about how the game works or the enemies you'll be facing off against, come on over and have a look!

Kickstarter link:
https://bit.ly/TWR_Kickstarter

There are also Kickstarter - exclusive goodies to be had, and early access to the demo of The White Raven for all backers too!

Hope to see you there!


- August

P.S. we also have an early bird discount that is only available for the first 24 hours!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: We're coming to Kickstarter!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/12700064adff43e7aa6cc6007fac4f76f0aa34d2.jpg

Greetings fellow Ravens!

We're incredibly excited to announce our Kickstarter campaign launch date:

We're launching on the 28th of June 2022!

Swing on by to grab some Kickstarter-exclusive goodies (including alternate outfits for your characters, your very own statue in the game, etc.) or if you're just simply curious about what our game has to offer - we're providing a TON of new details.

Here's the link to our Pre-Kickstarter page if you're interested:
www.kickstarter.com/projects/gatherroundstudios/the-white-raven

It's taken us a little while but we'd love for you to take a look at where we're at in development and our plans moving forward ːsteamhappyː

(oh and if you're interested in getting a sneak preview of some of our stretch goals, you can take a look here by signing up for our mailing list - see you there!)



- August from GatherRound Studios

notes.title: Welcome to The White Raven Steam page!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/0224605c8e7674147a011faae396cfca7f8c2367.png

Thanks so much for stopping by! 

We're really excited to bring you more news and updates about our Shamanic Tactical RPG.
We hope that you'll be able to join us every step of the way in our journey to bring you this adventure.

First things first:
We're going to be launching our Kickstarter campaign in the next few weeks!

This will be your chance to get some Kickstarter-exclusive goodies (including some exclusive armor + weapon packs for your party) as well as leaving your name in Greater Balhaea's history books!

Additionally, we'll be highlighting a bunch of details into the world of The White Raven - activities you can participate in, some of the characters you'll be able to meet (and possibly romance) and the like!

All you have to do is simply jump onto the link below to be notified when our Kickstarter campaign launches! We'll see you there!

thewhiteravengame.com/mailing-list

That's all I've got for you for today!
Hope all of you have a great week aheadːsteamhappyː

But until then,

May we meet again at the river of life.

- August from GatherRound Studios
